pass_a_gloss: Youngest and mother: creation ex nihilo confessed; tyrant unescaped.
pass_b_english: Last the youngest, with his mother. The tyrant promised riches and friendship, and bade the mother persuade her son to live. She in the fathers' tongue: 'My son, pity me, who bore thee nine months, nursed thee three years, reared thee; look on heaven and earth and all in them, and know God made them not from things that are — so too mankind comes to be. Fear not this tormentor, but, worthy of thy brethren, accept death, that in mercy I may receive thee with them.' (2 Maccabees 7:20–31) He answered: 'For whom wait ye? I obey not the king's command, but the law given through Moses. And thou, contriver of all evil against the Hebrews, shalt not escape God's hands.' So the seven with their mother were perfected, and the tyrant learned godliness is unconquered.
